title: 2020 AMC 10A Problem 9
statement: A single bench section at a school event can hold either \(7\) adults or \(11\) children. When \(N\) bench sections are connected end to end, an equal number of adults and children seated together will occupy all the bench space. What is the least possible positive integer value of \(N?\)

solutions.text:
If the equal number of adults and children is \(P\), then the adults use \(\frac{P}{7}\) bench sections and the children use \(\frac{P}{11}\) bench sections. Thus \(N=P\left(\dfrac17+\dfrac1{11}\right)=\dfrac{18P}{77}\).

The least positive integer occurs when \(P=77\), giving \(N=18\). Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Let the equal number of adults and children be \(P\)
The number of bench sections is \(\frac{P}{7}+\frac{P}{11}\)
